scope: Independent audit of all 40 completed raw-MI pilot jobs; not a statistical significance analysis

reference_label_audit.method: Read original reference_positive_edges.tsv into a source-by-target Boolean matrix, exclude self-pairs, flatten in frozen source/target order; did not call benchmark load_universe or pair_index

primary_at_5000_audit.method: Independent numpy.partition kth-score boundary followed by greater-than/equal-to Boolean counts and uniform boundary-tie expectation; did not call score_arrays

AUROC_independent_crosscheck.method: sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score on saved raw score arrays and independently verified labels

coordinator_checkpoint_incident.scope: Coordination/checkpoint finalization only; not a failed native scientific job
coordinator_checkpoint_incident.reported_incident: Windows PermissionError during replacement of status.json after 38 completed futures had been recorded, although all 40 per-job completion records already existed
coordinator_checkpoint_incident.recovery: Coordinator reran the same frozen runner with one worker; all 40 existing jobs were hash-verified and status was finalized complete without native reruns

limitations: All 40 primary top-k results were audited; independent scikit-learn AUROC sorting was limited to seeds 2 and 89 in each arm
Twenty resamples are not independent biological replicates
Reference positives are reconstructed perturbation responses, not proof of direct regulatory interactions
No significance or general biological superiority claim is made by this audit
